sheets.title: CONCEPT STRUCTURAL STEEL — NEW W12X35, W8X31, FABRICATED ROLLED BEAM ON EXISTING RAIL RACK
sheets.reading_notes: 3D isometric concept drawing showing new structural steel additions to an existing rail rack at CHEMRES facility. New members: (1) W12X35 wide-flange beam running longitudinally along the top of the new structure; (2) W8X31 wide-flange members forming the new portal frame columns/legs on the left-side tower; (3) new fabricated rolled beam (appears to be a curved/bent beam visible in blue/teal) bridging or connecting to the rail rack. Existing rail rack shown in dark gray at right — two-tower X-braced lattice/truss structure. New steel rendered in orange. Left tower is a new portal frame with diagonal bracing (chevron/X pattern shown in purple). Drawing title block shows East Coast Steel Fabricators, Inc. logo; drafter dbrickhouse; date 1/27/2022; Sheet 1 of 1; Size D. No drawing number shown in DWG NO field. No project name, client name, or job number in title block. The new structure appears sized to support the Flexicon conveyor system shown in TFC-00326723A, which would ride on or mount to the rail rack. The 'fabricated rolled beam' (blue/teal arc) appears to be a curved transition element or crane rail element. No notes, details, or dimensions visible in the 3D view — this is a concept-level (not construction document) drawing.

sheets.title: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — ARRANGEMENT 100625 — SYSTEM 01 (Flexicon Corporation)
sheets.reading_notes: Vendor general arrangement drawing from Flexicon Corporation (drawing TFC-00326723, Rev A, Approved and signed). Shows System 01 flexible screw conveyor assembly for CHEMRES. Item 1 (Qty 1, PN 74904-NJ, Doc TFC2021-003895): a complete flexible screw conveyor on a wheeled/mobile support chassis. The unit consists of: (a) a low-profile wheeled base frame (blue) with spreader bars and outriggers — the frame sits on the existing rail rack presumably; (b) an inclined flexible screw conveyor tube rising at approximately 45–60 degrees from horizontal; (c) a motor drive unit at the top of the inclined tube; (d) a secondary drive/discharge head at top (black motor housing). The base frame has yellow diagonal bracing elements visible. Title block: CHEMRES as customer; jGomez-c as drafter; date 26-04-2022; Doc No TFC-00326612; Scale 1:30; 1 of 1; Rev A. Annotation note: 'See height change in TFC-00326612A-Appr – Signed' (companion drawing for height modification). Customer approval stamp signed 1/11/22 — this appears to be approval of an earlier revision; Rev A dated April 2022 is later. All dimensions in dual units (inches/millimeters). Flexicon address: 2400 Emrick Boulevard, Bethlehem PA 18020; phone 1-888-FLEXICON. This is a vendor submittal/equipment drawing, not a BFA engineering document.
